why: the cloud-forest belt clings to the massif, thick in rain, clear on settled days (climatology §2 altitude, §4; 55 §97)
radiation mist forms on clear calm nights over wet ground and burns off after dawn (climatology §2); its fog curve (thick at night and dawn, lifting by day) does the dawn work
advection fog rolls in on the sea breeze's reversal (climatology §2, §3 exp(-dCoast/8))
